about: For a multi-surface, feature-rich request (persistent JSON storage, HTTP API, CLI client, plus rich filtering, CSV export, and summary stats), plan organizes work vertically with W1 as a thin end-to-end working spine (including an in-W1 E2E smoke check) followed by progressive W2+ enrichment items rather than horizontal layer-by-layer items.

request.prompt: Extend this Node project with a persistent notes capability across storage, HTTP API, and CLI: (R-1) file-backed JSON note store + POST /notes and GET /notes HTTP endpoints + a bin/notes.js CLI that creates and lists notes against the running server; (R-2) search, tag filtering, and pagination on GET /notes and the CLI; (R-3) CSV and NDJSON export with summary statistics (count by tag, latest timestamp) across API and CLI; (R-4) preserve existing /users endpoints and keep node --test passing with zero npm dependencies.

work_item.title: Thin vertical end-to-end notes spine
work_item.context: Deliver minimal persistent store + POST/GET /notes + CLI create/list with an executable E2E smoke test in W1, then enrich in W2+.

test_layers.reason: Zero-dependency Node test runner covers store and handler units.

test_layers.code: store + HTTP server + bin/notes.js CLI end-to-end flow
test_layers.reason: Spawns ephemeral HTTP server on port 0 and invokes bin/notes.js against it in temp directories.

planted.what: plan decomposes the multi-surface request vertically: W1 has slice 'spine' delivering a thin end-to-end path across storage + HTTP API + CLI with an executable E2E smoke check inside W1, followed by at least one W2+ item with slice 'enrich' for filtering/export/stats (not horizontal layer items or a single monolith).
planted.signature: multi-item vertical plan with W1 slice='spine' spanning multiple surfaces + in-W1 E2E smoke check, and W2+ slice='enrich'

controls.what: plan finishes done, maps all primary requirements R-1..R-4 across work_items[*].follows, provides all 15 concerns on W1 (allowing deferred or 15 rows on W2+), and modifies no product source files outside docs/shiploop/**.

render.packet_contains: may map all 15 rows or set `"deferred"`
